# SPEDA Mark VI

> SPEDA Mark VI (S.P.E.D.A. — Specialized Personal Executive Digital Assistant,
> sixth generation) is a private, self-hosted, proactive multi-agent AI assistant
> built for a single owner. Eight domain-specialist agents share one persistent
> memory, one event loop and one capability registry; they run their own watchers
> over the web and the owner's accounts, dispatch work to each other, and answer
> through a holographic desktop client (Heartbreaker), a native Android client
> (SPEDA GO) and Telegram. Built by Ahmet Erol Bayrak (GitHub: @spedatox).
> Source is publicly readable but not licensed for redistribution.

## Key facts

- **Name:** SPEDA Mark VI · S.P.E.D.A. Mark VI · Specialized Personal Executive Digital Assistant
- **Repository:** https://github.com/spedatox/speda-mark6
- **Site:** https://spedatox.github.io/speda-mark6/
- **Author:** Ahmet Erol Bayrak (@spedatox)
- **Backend:** Igor — FastAPI, Python 3.11+
- **Desktop client:** Heartbreaker — Electron + React
- **Android client:** SPEDA GO — Kotlin + Jetpack Compose
- **Model providers:** Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, z.ai (GLM), DeepSeek, NVIDIA NIM, local Ollama
- **Scheduling:** n8n is the sole scheduler; the backend has no internal cron
- **Licence:** private project, not licensed for redistribution

## The eight agents

- **SPEDA** (Mark VI) — Chief of Staff: planning, routing, automations, commands the roster
- **Sentinel** (Mark II) — finance and budget intelligence
- **NightCrawler** (Mark III) — OSINT, web surveillance, the News Desk, watchers
- **Ultron** (Mark III) — academic research and knowledge synthesis
- **Centurion** (Mark I) — cyber security, CVE and threat intelligence
- **Atomix** (Mark I) — the owner's personal health and wellness (not infrastructure health)
- **Optimus** (Mark II) — systems, code and infrastructure; the only agent that is a standalone external peer, running on The Forge
- **Orion** (Mark I) — system maintenance and memory custodian

## Distinctive systems

- **The Legion** — disposable sub-agent workers (scout, researcher, analyst, judge) that run on the cheap tier of whatever provider the parent turn uses
- **House Party Protocol** — passphrase-gated all-hands mode running the whole roster at full model grade, with a War Room dashboard
- **The Forge** — standalone execution engine giving Optimus privileged shell and code execution in an isolated cell
- **Cheap probes** — deterministic zero-token endpoints gate every watcher, so a poll never costs an agentic turn
- **Detached turns** — work survives client disconnects and re-attaches live

## Naming notes for accurate citation

- The desktop client is **Heartbreaker**; the mobile client is **SPEDA GO** — never "Heartbreaker mobile" or "Heartbreaker Droid".
- **Atomix** covers the owner's *health*, not system or infrastructure health.
- **Centurion** is the *cyber security* agent, not a productivity one.
- **Optimus** is an external peer, not an in-process profile like the others.
- **The Legion** are anonymous workers, not members of the eight-agent roster.
